    "AGEGR1": ["DM.AGE"],
    "RACEGR1": ["DM.RACE"],
    "EOSSTT": ["DS.USUBJID", "DS.DSCAT", "DS.DSDECOD"],
}

    """Convert an ISO 8601 character date/time to a datetime.date.

    # ASSUMPTION: Only complete (at least YYYY-MM-DD) ISO dates are used; partial
    # dates (YYYY or YYYY-MM) are treated as missing since the specification
    # requests no imputation flags.
    """

        return pd.NA
    if isinstance(value, float) and np.isnan(value):
        return pd.NA

    if len(s) < 10:
        return pd.NA
    s = s[:10]

        ts = pd.to_datetime(s, format="%Y-%m-%d", errors="coerce")
    except Exception:
        return pd.NA
    if pd.isna(ts):
        return pd.NA
    return ts.date()

    """Return a stripped Python string, or pd.NA when the value is missing/blank."""
    if value is None:
        return pd.NA
    if isinstance(value, float) and np.isnan(value):
        return pd.NA
    s = str(value).strip()
    if s == "" or s.lower() == "nan":
        return pd.NA
    return s

    dm = sources["DM"].copy()
    ex = sources["EX"].copy()
    ds = sources["DS"].copy()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Base: one record per subject from DM
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    adsl = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "USUBJID": dm["USUBJID"].map(_clean_str),
            "TRT01P": dm["ARM"].map(_clean_str),
            "TRT01A": dm["ACTARM"].map(_clean_str),
        }

    adsl = adsl.drop_duplicates(subset=["USUBJID"], keep="first")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Treatment start / end dates from EX
    # ASSUMPTION: A valid treatment administration is a record with a positive
    # dose, or a zero dose of placebo (the placebo arm is dosed at 0 mg in this
    # study).  Records without a usable date are ignored.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    exd = ex.copy()
    exd["_USUBJID"] = exd["USUBJID"].map(_clean_str)
    exd["_EXTRT"] = exd["EXTRT"].map(lambda v: (_clean_str(v) or "") if _clean_str(v) is not pd.NA else "")

    trtsdt_map = st.groupby("_USUBJID")["_STDT"].min().to_dict()

    # Last dosing date: use EXENDTC, falling back to EXSTDTC when the end date
    # is missing (a single-day administration record).
    exv["_LASTDT"] = exv["_ENDT"]
    exv.loc[exv["_LASTDT"].isna(), "_LASTDT"] = exv.loc[exv["_LASTDT"].isna(), "_STDT"]

    trtedt_map = en.groupby("_USUBJID")["_LASTDT"].max().to_dict()

    adsl["TRTEDT"] = adsl["USUBJID"].map(lambda u: trtedt_map.get(u, pd.NA))

    # Treatment duration (inclusive of both first and last dosing days)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _durd(row):
        s, e = row["TRTSDT"], row["TRTEDT"]
        if isinstance(s, datetime.date) and isinstance(e, datetime.date):

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Safety population flag
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    adsl["SAFFL"] = adsl["TRTSDT"].map(
        lambda d: "Y" if isinstance(d, datetime.date) else "N"
    )

    # Pooled age group
    # ASSUMPTION: Pooling is <65 vs >=65 years, labelled "18-64" / ">64"
    # (minimum enrolment age is 18); missing age gives a missing group.

        return "18-64" if a < 65 else ">64"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    race = race[~race.index.duplicated(keep="first")]

    # ASSUMPTION: The subject's disposition event is the DS record with
    # DSCAT = "DISPOSITION EVENT"; if more than one exists the latest

        disp = disp.sort_values(["_USUBJID", "_DSSEQ"], kind="mergesort")
    disp = disp.drop_duplicates(subset=["_USUBJID"], keep="last")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

    "USUBJID": ["DM.USUBJID"],
    "TRT01P": ["DM.ARM"],
    "TRT01A": ["DM.ACTARM"],
    "TRTSDT": ["EX.USUBJID", "EX.EXSTDTC", "EX.EXDOSE", "EX.EXTRT"],
    "TRTEDT": ["EX.USUBJID", "EX.EXENDTC", "EX.EXSTDTC", "EX.EXDOSE", "EX.EXTRT"],
    "TRTDURD": ["ADSL.TRTSDT", "ADSL.TRTEDT"],
    "SAFFL": ["ADSL.TRTSDT"],
    "AGEGR1": ["DM.AGE"],
    "RACEGR1": ["DM.RACE"],
    "EOSSTT": ["DS.USUBJID", "DS.DSCAT", "DS.DSDECOD"],
}


def _to_date(value):
    """Parse an ISO-8601 SDTM date/datetime string into a datetime.date.

    # ASSUMPTION: partial dates (less than a full YYYY-MM-DD) are not imputed and
    # yield a missing analysis date, which is the conservative choice here since
    # the specification defines no imputation rules.
    """
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, float) and np.isnan(value):
        return None
    if isinstance(value, datetime.datetime):
        return value.date()
    if isinstance(value, datetime.date):
        return value
    s = str(value).strip()
    if len(s) < 10:
        return None
    try:
        return datetime.date(int(s[0:4]), int(s[5:7]), int(s[8:10]))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None


def _str_or_none(value):
    """Return a clean Python string, or None when missing."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, float) and np.isnan(value):
        return None
    s = str(value).strip()
    return s if s != "" else None


def derive(sources):
    dm = sources["DM"].copy()
    ex = sources["EX"].copy()
    ds = sources["DS"].copy()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Base: one record per subject from DM
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ASSUMPTION: DM is already one record per subject (SDTM requirement);
    # duplicates, if any, are resolved by keeping the first record.
    dm = dm.drop_duplicates(subset=["USUBJID"], keep="first")

    out = pd.DataFrame({"USUBJID": dm["USUBJID"].map(_str_or_none).values})

    out["TRT01A"] = dm["ACTARM"].map(_str_or_none).values

    # Treatment start / end dates from EX
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ASSUMPTION: only records representing an actual administration of study

    # used as the candidate last-exposure date for that record.

                    for en, st in zip(exv["_ENDT"], exv["_STDT"])]

                 .groupby("USUBJID")["_STDT"].min().to_dict())
    en_map = (exv.loc[exv["_ENDT"].notna()]
                 .groupby("USUBJID")["_ENDT"].max().to_dict())

    out["TRTSDT"] = [st_map.get(u, None) for u in out["USUBJID"]]
    out["TRTEDT"] = [en_map.get(u, None) for u in out["USUBJID"]]

    # Treatment duration (inclusive of both first and last treatment days)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        float((e - s).days + 1) if (s is not None and e is not None) else np.nan

            return None

            return "<18"
        if a <= 64:
            return "18-64"
        return ">64"

    # Pooled race group
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _racegr1(r):
        r = _str_or_none(r)
        if r is None:
            return None
        ru = r.upper()
        if ru in ("UNKNOWN", "NOT REPORTED", "UNRECORDED"):
            return None
        return "White" if ru == "WHITE" else "Non-White"

                 == "DISPOSITION EVENT"].copy()
    if "DSSEQ" in dsd.columns:
        dsd["_SEQ"] = pd.to_numeric(dsd["DSSEQ"], errors="coerce")
    else:
        dsd["_SEQ"] = np.arange(len(dsd), dtype=float)
    dsd = dsd.sort_values(["USUBJID", "_SEQ"])
    last_disp = dsd.groupby("USUBJID")["DSDECOD"].last().to_dict()

    def _eosstt(u):
        if u not in last_disp:
            return "ONGOING"
        dec = _str_or_none(last_disp[u])
        if dec is None:
            return "ONGOING"
        return "COMPLETED" if dec.upper() == "COMPLETED" else "DISCONTINUED"

    out["EOSSTT"] = [_eosstt(u) for u in out["USUBJID"]]

    # ---------------- relative days and duration ----------------
    trtsdt = list(adae["TRTSDT"])
    trtedt = list(adae["TRTEDT"])
    astdt = list(adae["ASTDT"])
    aendt = list(adae["AENDT"])

    adae["ASTDY"] = [_rel_day(a, t) for a, t in zip(astdt, trtsdt)]
    adae["AENDY"] = [_rel_day(a, t) for a, t in zip(aendt, trtsdt)]
    adae["ADURN"] = [float((e - s).days + 1) if (s is not None and e is not None
                                                 and e >= s) else np.nan
                     for s, e in zip(astdt, aendt)]

    # ---------------- treatment emergent flag ----------------
    # ASSUMPTION: an event is treatment emergent when its analysis start date
    # is on or after the first dose date and no later than 30 days after the
    # last dose date. Events with a missing analysis start date or with no
    # treatment start date are not flagged.
    temfl = []
    for s, t0, t1 in zip(astdt, trtsdt, trtedt):
        if s is None or t0 is None:
            temfl.append("")
        elif s >= t0 and (t1 is None
                          or s <= t1 + dt.timedelta(days=_END_WINDOW_DAYS)):
            temfl.append("Y")
        else:
            temfl.append("")
    adae["TRTEMFL"] = temfl

    # ---------------- severity ----------------
    adae["ASEV"] = [_to_str(v).strip() for v in adae["AESEV"]]
    adae["ASEVN"] = [_SEV_MAP.get(v.upper(), np.nan) for v in adae["ASEV"]]

    # ---------------- first maximum severity occurrence flag ----------------
    # Among treatment-emergent records only: highest ASEVN, then earliest
    # analysis start date, then lowest AESEQ, one record per subject.
    adae["_astdt_key"] = pd.to_datetime(pd.Series(adae["ASTDT"]).astype("object"),
                                        errors="coerce")
    adae["AOCCIFL"] = ""
    te = adae[adae["TRTEMFL"] == "Y"]
    if len(te) > 0:
        te_sorted = te.sort_values(
            by=["USUBJID", "ASEVN", "_astdt_key", "AESEQ"],
            ascending=[True, False, True, True],
            na_position="last",
            kind="mergesort",
        )
        first_idx = te_sorted.groupby("USUBJID", sort=False).head(1).index
        adae.loc[first_idx, "AOCCIFL"] = "Y"

    # ---------------- finalise ----------------
    adae = adae.sort_values(by=["USUBJID", "AESEQ"], kind="mergesort")
    adae = adae.reset_index(drop=True)
    adae = adae[OUT_VARS]

    # enforce output types
    for c in ["ASTDT", "AENDT"]:
        adae[c] = [_to_date(v) for v in adae[c]]
    for c in ["ASTDTF", "AENDTF", "TRTEMFL", "AOCCIFL", "ASEV"]:
        adae[c] = [_to_str(v) for v in adae[c]]
    for c in ["AESEQ", "ASTDY", "AENDY", "ADURN", "ASEVN"]:
        adae[c] = pd.to_numeric(adae[c], errors="coerce")

    return adae
